issue.title: bob --version reports its build commit so host-currency gates can check ancestry

task_type_fields.proposal: Make `bob --version` identify the exact build, not only the Cargo version. Every Bob host (athena, apollo, mac) installs bob with `cargo install --path` from a master checkout, so `bob --version` prints `bob 0.6.0` whatever commit it was built from. Embed the git commit (and a dirty flag) at build time (for example a `build.rs` that reads `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git status --porcelain`, falling back cleanly for crates.io/tarball builds without `.git`), print it in `--version` (and any JSON version output), and teach `scripts/dev/bob-host-currency` to check `git merge-base --is-ancestor <commit> <host-build>` directly. That would retire the per-feature behavior probes (`--probe bold-drawer-read`) that bob-cli-ph.3 had to invent because release rows cannot see master installs (option B in research drawer_reader_gate_without_release, file:explicit:561d0b66f8faf13282515d16). Changing `--version` output is a CLI contract change (mark it `!` if any consumer parses it; check bob-mac-capture's version handshake and install-all digests first).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Proposed by bob-cli-ph.3 note #12 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-ph land agent. The true-case drawer epic only needed a host-currency gate, which the bold-drawer-read probe already satisfied on all three hosts; build provenance in --version is a general tooling capability that changes the version output contract and needs its own design.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ph.3 had to invent behavior probes because every host builds bob from master and prints the same 0.6.0 version; embedding the build commit would let future rollout gates check ancestry directly.
